themeDescription: Why banks are investing heavily in AI, cybersecurity, and digital identity.
numberLabel: RBI penalty imposed on Bank of Baroda for regulatory non-compliance.

vocabulary.definition: A scheduled re-verification of a customer's identity and details, done at intervals set by risk category.

questions.question: Why did RBI impose the penalty?
questions.answer: For failing to complete periodic KYC updates within the required timeline for a segment of customer accounts.

stories.headline: RBI issues new guidelines on periodic KYC review
stories.summary: What it means for banks and customers.
stories.quickRead: RBI tightened the timeline banks must follow for re-verifying customer identity.
stories.understandRead: RBI has shortened the window banks get to complete periodic KYC reviews, especially for higher-risk accounts.
stories.deepDiveRead:
## Background
KYC review cycles in India are risk-tiered.

## What changes
Banks must now show an auditable trail.
stories.whatHappened: RBI tightened enforcement of periodic KYC review timelines.
stories.whyToday: The penalty was disclosed today alongside a fresh RBI circular.
stories.whyCare: You may be asked to re-verify your KYC sooner than expected.
stories.whatNext: Expect other banks to announce KYC catch-up drives.

ifYoureWondering.q: Does this mean my bank is unsafe?
ifYoureWondering.a: No — this is a process penalty, not a solvency issue.
